name: vibe-quiz
description: Keeps you in the loop on AI-assisted work: short multiple-choice quizzes about what was just built and why, with configurable depth and frequency.

trigger.title: Quiz trigger
trigger.description: When quizzes start automatically: every N Claude replies (turns) or every N commits. 'manual' means only when you run /vibe-quiz:quiz.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: For 'turns' or 'commits': quiz every N Claude replies or every N commits.

questions_per_quiz.title: Questions per quiz
questions_per_quiz.description: How many multiple-choice questions each quiz asks (1–4).

depth.title: Question depth
depth.description: One of: recall (what was done), understand (why), apply (consequences) or challenge (critique and alternatives).

focus.title: Question focus
focus.description: One of: decisions, implementation or both.
